g.text: The five walking conditions do not form cleanly separated groups

text.style: font-size: 6.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #b94e48

g.text: The closest condition averages are only 0.030 apart, while examples within one condition vary by 0.113 on average. The groups therefore overlap substantially.
